name: Itajime
description: Clamp-resist shibori: indigo cloth folded into squares, each one left with a soft pale window in the middle and blurred pale seams where the folds were pressed.

code.style: --rule: ( --k: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 6%, #000 14% 27%, transparent 36% 64%, #000 73% 86%, transparent 94%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 6%, #000 14% 86%, transparent 94%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 6%, #000 14% 27%, transparent 36% 64%, #000 73% 86%, transparent 94%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 6%, #000 14% 86%, transparent 94%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @var(--k); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 6%, #000 14% 86%, transparent 94%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 6%, #000 14% 27%, transparent 36% 64%, #000 73% 86%, transparent 94%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 6%, #000 14% 86%, transparent 94%), linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 6%, #000 14% 27%, transparent 36% 64%, #000 73% 86%, transparent 94%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
